details: `url.Values` keeps each key's values in an insertion-ordered Map, as Go's map, where `get`, `all`, `has`, `add`, `set` and `remove` scanned a key list and `add` and `parse_query` copied a key's values to add one, so a handler reading every key of a query a peer fills with up to 10,000 parameters, or one key's 10,000 values, did quadratic work (Mac: reading every key 65 ms to 0.15 ms, Go 0.17 ms; one key's values 189 ms to 0.54 ms).
